items.name: Asp Stance
items.text: Irabel enters a stance wherein she adopts a fluid, sinuous set of motions that mimic the striking of a venomous serpent. Her fist Strikes deal piercing damage while she's in Asp Stance, and she gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. When she targets the same creature with two Strikes from her Flurry of Blows, if both Strikes hit, the target becomes Sickened 1 from the pain.

items.name: Flurry of Blows
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Irabel makes two fist Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine the damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Apply her multiple attack penalty to the Strikes normally.

items.name: Powerful Fist
items.text: Irabel doesn't take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with her fist or any other unarmed attack.
